title: Last Night’s Dream: a toxic gassing?
content: Last night‘s dream: I was in the mall world. There were multiple people who are real people who I’ve seen in real life there. It starts out with us watching this movie that is about Pearl Harbor. Eventually, we all start feeling gassed that there is a toxic gas in the air so we’re all running into the mall, running into this room that I think was PacSun, the store. There were windows on the ceiling. I forget what those are called. Everybody is in the room we thought we were safe, but then some people started to feel kind of dizzy so we realize there must be a leak of gas somewhere so we’re all trying to break out we go into this back room that is more like a bookstore and we think we’re going to go into another room from there, but it takes us outside and there are people playing football outside. I remember seeing Aaron Rodgers and all those people were fine, which we couldn’t make sense of and I remember tearing a hole into this cruise ship thinking that I could hide in there and that nothing would be able to get me ,the gas wouldn’t be able to reach me, but it was like a video game where you get stuck in a place it’s glitching you can’t move and that’s the last thing that I remember. Just thought I would share my latest dream journal entry and my first trip to mall world in 2026 😅
